chansons.style: Roots reggae, offbeat skank guitar, deep heavy bass, warm male vocal, positive vibes, peaceful atmosphere, steady 75 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Un hymne roots reggae apaisant qui célèbre l'unité, la fin des conflits et l'amour universel.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
Yeah, man.
Feel the breeze.
Let the worries fade.

[Verse 1]
Sun is rising over the mountain top
Hear the rhythm and the heartbeat drop
No more fighting, put the weapons down
Spread the love across the town

[Pre-Chorus]
We are one under the sky so blue
Me and you, yeah, me and you

[Chorus]
Peace and love, let the river flow
Peace and love, let the good seeds grow
Hold your brother, never let him fall
One heart, one mind, one love for all

[Verse 2]
Walk together on the golden sand
Healing waters wash across the land
Leave the anger in the dust behind
Open up your spirit and your mind

[Pre-Chorus]
We are one under the sky so blue
Me and you, yeah, me and you

[Chorus]
Peace and love, let the river flow
Peace and love, let the good seeds grow
Hold your brother, never let him fall
One heart, one mind, one love for all

[Bridge]
Hear the drums beating slow and steady
Tell the children that the world is ready
For a brand new day without the tears
Washing away the heavy years

[Chorus]
Peace and love, let the river flow
Peace and love, let the good seeds grow
Hold your brother, never let him fall
One heart, one mind, one love for all

[Outro]
One love.
Fade into the light.
Peace.

On court plus vite que le vent

[Chorus]

Le sport nous donne la délivrance

Le sport nous donne la délivrance
Un pas, deux pas, vers la victoire

Jamais abandonner.
Le rythme du sport.

Paix.

chansons.style: Lovers rock reggae, smooth electric piano, heavy slow bassline, emotional male vocal, deep heartbreak vibe, steady 82 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Un lovers rock poignant sur la fin d'une relation et l'acceptation douloureuse de la séparation.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
Yeah.
It's over now.
Let it go.

[Verse 1]
I see your pictures on the bedroom wall
Waiting for a phone that will never call
We built a castle out of shifting sand
Now I am walking through a broken land

[Pre-Chorus]
The tears are falling like the heavy rain
Washing away the joy and the pain

[Chorus]
We said goodbye, the music stopped
The little seed that we planted dropped
No more fighting, no more lies
I see the truth inside your eyes

[Verse 2]
You packed your bags and walked out the door
I cannot give you what you wanted more
The fire is cold, the ashes turn to gray
I have to find my own brand new way

[Pre-Chorus]
The tears are falling like the heavy rain
Washing away the joy and the pain

[Chorus]
We said goodbye, the music stopped
The little seed that we planted dropped
No more fighting, no more lies
I see the truth inside your eyes

[Bridge]
Maybe someday we will understand
Why love slipped right through our hand
But for tonight I smoke and I pray
To heal the wounds and walk away

[Chorus]
We said goodbye, the music stopped
The little seed that we planted dropped
No more fighting, no more lies
I see the truth inside your eyes

[Outro]
Walk away.
Find the light.
Goodbye.

Au-delà des peurs et des chagrins
